laws.rule: Under a Niigata prefectural ordinance, anyone entering the active-volcano zone of Niigata-Yakeyama (within 2 km of the summit), including for fishing or gathering wild plants, must lodge a climbing notification with the governor: online through Compass or YAMAP, by email, post, fax or in person to the prefecture, through the police, or in the boxes at the Itoigawa and Myoko trailheads (removed in winter). Climbing without one brings the penalty provisions into play.

festivals.what: Nagaoka Festival, Nagaoka City: starts on 1 August, the anniversary of the 1945 Nagaoka air raid, with the city's peace ceremony; the Grand Fireworks follow on 2 and 3 August over the Shinano River (the 2026 dates given by the city). Viewing is by paid seat.
